data.summary_en: To optimize LLM kernels on rare accelerators, a multi-agent loop lets model self-build/review DSL documentation summaries, microbenchmarks, and compiler legality rules, with role-based search on each kernel's Design Tree. Three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels on FuriosaAI RNGD NPU reached 9.293x geometric mean speedup over official baseline.
